notes:
Group F. Method: global SE->DX9 vtable slot map (co-occurrence DP over all uEnemy-derived classes; e.g. SE 21 kill->DX9 12, 53 main->30, 54 updatePtr->31, 59 damageMessage->36, 118/119 getHitPoint/getMaxHitPoint->81/82), unique string sets, ordered callee/caller alignment with immediates/floats/named-callee similarity, caller-set signatures, then manual DX9-source-order gap fill with decompile checks (setMotion, addSpeed, setCylinderEffectOn, uEm027 setAction switch, setShootInitByAgnus).
Key observations:
- DX9 code order = source order (setX immediately followed by X/XLoop); SE (LTCG) groups tiny setX stubs first, so SE address order is NOT usable for order-fill.
- Most 18-28 byte SE setX(void) stubs are inlined into setAction/SetAction in DX9 (uEm017 ~45, uEm018 ~55, uEm026 ~8). Verified for uEm027: DX9 setAction 0x6F5FF0 inlines cases 2-5 (Left/RightWalkShort/Long) and has NO case 11 (SyncAtkD) or 22 (DmgBarrierC) -> setSyncAtkD/syncAtkD/setDmgBarrierC/dmgBarrierC are SE-only content.
- uEm027 vtable: the DX9 label uEm027::vftable at 0xBD6760 was actually the embedded uEm027::uCamCtrl vtable (getDTI slot -> uCamCtrl::DTI). Real uEm027 vtable is 0xBD65B8 (103 slots), written by ctor 0x6F3DB0; both relabelled.
- uEm017::setMotion is a class-new virtual in DX9 (slot 103) but an inherited base virtual (slot 35) in SE.
- Existing DX9 names corrected (old name kept in comment): uEm017/uEm018/uEm026 ::die -> ::kill (vtable slot 12 = SE kill; SE die() is a separate non-virtual state fn), ::validateTargetPtrs -> ::updatePtr, uEm018::damageMessage6 -> ::effectGuardMessage.
- Slot-0 deleting destructors are undefined-code labels (loc_) in DX9; named via mangled ??_E/??_G and ~dtors via ??1 so IDA demangles them.
- SE-only (SE-added content): grabLongMessageV, setGrabSnatchTrish, isHighTimeDamage (uEm017); holdMessage/setGrabBlown empty in DX9 (nullsubs at slots 103/104 of uEm018); uEm026::setDeltaTimeRate (SE slot 144, absent from DX9 vtable).
- Shared/folded vtable entries recorded as medium with no rename: uEm017::getCenterJoint -> uPlayerNero::GetChestJoint 0x8ABBE0; uEm017::transFreeze -> sub_618400; uEm026::updateMaterial -> 0x6E4370 (in uEm025 region); uEm026::getEffectElementMessage -> 0x72F300; uEm026::getCenterJoint -> sub_66B950; uEm018FireShl::createProperty -> sub_5CED90; several SE overrides map to nullsub_2/3/8 in DX9 (empty bodies).
- uEm018::FireShl::create is called from uEm018::MagmaCtrl (0x642CC0) - cross-class call confirms both.
- DX9 extra: cThinkMgrEm018::getDTI 0x6309D0 lives in uEm018 TU (no SE counterpart in group list); 0x630A30 is a getMaxHitPoint-style stub shared by uEm006/010/012/018.
